title: Atila iAMP COVID-19 Detection Kit - Saliva
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Arrange deck and tube racks
steps.instruction: Place tube racks on the deck in slot order 1, 2, 3, …, 7. Load the pipette mounts as specified (left or right for the P20 and P300). The pipette will access tube racks sequentially starting with the rack in slot 1, moving by column order A1, B1, C1, A2, B2, C2, etc.

substeps.instruction: For a 94‑sample run, fill tube racks in slots 1‑6 completely and place four tubes (A1, B1, C1, A2) in the rack on slot 7.
Slot 8 must always hold a non‑skirted plate; slot 9 holds the reaction plate (choose non‑skirted or half‑skirted as required).

steps.title: Determine mastermix dispensing scheme
steps.instruction: Based on the specified number of samples (1‑94), decide how to dispense the mastermix:

substeps.instruction: If running a full plate (94 samples), use the multi‑channel pipette to dispense mastermix into all 96 wells of the reaction plate.

If running fewer than 94 samples (e.g., 12 samples), use the multi‑channel pipette to dispense mastermix into the entire first column, then use the single‑channel pipette to dispense mastermix into the first four wells of column 2, and finally dispense mastermix into wells G12 and H12. Provide extra mastermix for the first four wells of column 1 because the pipette will draw mastermix from the column it is currently dispensing.

steps.title: Dispense mastermix into reaction plate
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate volume of mastermix to each well of the reaction plate up to the number of samples specified, following the scheme defined in the previous step.

steps.title: Add samples to mastermix wells
steps.instruction: Transfer each saliva sample from its tube rack to the corresponding mastermix well in the reaction plate.

steps.title: Add assay controls
steps.instruction: Add the positive and negative controls to wells G12 and H12 of the reaction plate, respectively.
